title: Intel OT-ST722 PCIe x4 82576F2 Dual- 1G SFP Ethernet Network Card

items.h: PCI Express x4 Interface (Compatible with x8/x16 slots)

tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The Intel OT-ST722 PCIe x4 82576F2 Dual Port 1G SFP Ethernet Network Card is a high-performance server-grade networking solution designed for reliable fiber connectivity. Powered by the Intel 82576F2 controller, this dual-port Gigabit Ethernet adapter ensures stable and efficient network performance for servers, workstations, and enterprise networking environments.


Built with a PCIe x4 interface, this network card delivers fast data transfer rates while maintaining low CPU utilization through advanced hardware offloading features. It supports 10/100/1000 Mbps speeds per port and uses SFP fiber modules, making it ideal for long-distance and secure fiber network connections.


Key Features


  • Dual Port 1G SFP Fiber Ethernet Interface
  • Powered by Intel 82576F2 Server-Grade Controller
  • PCI Express x4 Interface (Compatible with x8/x16 slots)
  • Supports 10/100/1000 Mbps Auto-Negotiation
  • Jumbo Frame Support for Enhanced Performance
  • PXE Boot & Wake-on-LAN (WoL) Support
  • Low Power Consumption & Stable Operation
  • Includes Low Profile & Standard Brackets
